Package com.j3d.engine.scene.copy

Record Class Copy

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.j3d.engine.scene.copy.Copy
Record Components:
original - The UUID of the original GObject from which this copy was made.
copy - The GObject instance that is the actual copy.
public record Copy(UUID original, GObject copy) extends Record
Represents a copy of a GObject, linking it back to its original.

The equality and hash code stuff are based solely on the original UUID, meaning two Copy instances are considered equal if they refer to the same original object, regardless of the actual GObject instance they hold as a copy.

Author:
